notes.title: Update 11/25/2020
notes.content:
It has been updated
1 Valletine against darkne now has full compatibility with xbox 360 control or higher.
2 Some bugs have been fixed.
3 Some menus layouts have been improved.
4 The pause command was modified, the pause screen now has a cleaner look without buttons.

notes.title: update 10/26/2020
notes.content: No collision and screen limit bugs were fixed in scenario 2 and the ice bridge bug in scenario 13 was fixed.

notes.title: update 10/22/2020
notes.content:

2-Some level design improvements

notes.title: update
notes.content:
